'''Tasariq City''' was a city on [[Tasariq]] built on an artificial island inside a large crater. It contained a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and was connected to [[Elikann Crater]] and [[Barimoq Crater]] by an underground rapid-transit tube. The [[Imperial Ministry of Tourism]] listed it as one of the [[Wonders of the Galaxy/Legends|Wonders of the Galaxy]].<ref name="J15">''{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}''</ref>
